product.name: Cart & Checkout
product.description: Cart and checkout for any website: carts with reconciliation and guest merge, a checkout form defined as data (fields, per-country address formats, phone patterns, autocomplete), manual payments (bank transfer with proof upload, cash on delivery with surcharge, caps, advance and a confirmation step, pay at pickup), a payment-gateway adapter interface (preview), coupons, deals and loyalty points through those products' APIs, an atomic idempotent placement transaction with race-free stock reservation and expiry, a success page that follows the real order state, policies and a sign-in gate — every price recomputed on the server, all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Cart
elements.description: Carts in the merchant's database: lines priced on the server from the items your server posts (or the Catalog product mirrors), caps on lines and quantities, reconciliation of price and stock changes, notes, guest carts merged on sign-in, cart.updated@1 and abandoned-cart events.

elements.name: Checkout form
elements.description: Contact, address, delivery and custom fields defined as data: per-country address formats, required fields, phone patterns, autocomplete tokens, labels from the strings; delivery methods with fees and free thresholds; saved addresses for signed-in shoppers.

elements.name: Order placement
elements.description: One atomic, idempotent placement (Idempotency-Key): prices and totals recomputed on the server, stock reserved race-free in a transaction of the merchant's database (compensated steps without a replica set), coupons, deals and points reserved through their products, order numbering, holds that expire, open-order caps and a blocklist; publishes order.placed@1.

elements.name: Manual payments
elements.description: Bank transfer (details, hold hours), cash on delivery (surcharge, minimum and maximum order, advance by transfer, a confirmation step that expires) and pay at pickup — each with availability rules (rules@1); the open-order cap counts every unconfirmed order.

elements.name: Bank-transfer proofs
elements.description: Shoppers upload a transfer screenshot or PDF for an unpaid order straight to the merchant's own storage (presigned PUT with signed content type and exact length), with the transfer reference; staff open it from the dashboard.

elements.name: Payment gateway (preview)
elements.description: Preview: online payments through a provider adapter (app-kit payments connector: createPayment, capture, refund, status, verifyWebhook) with the merchant's own gateway credentials. Ships the interface and a test adapter only.

elements.name: Offers
elements.description: Applies the Coupons product's codes and the Deals product's automatic offers to the checkout through their quote APIs, honouring their stacking flags; the codes are reserved and the deals committed at placement.

elements.name: Loyalty points
elements.description: Signed-in shoppers redeem points from the Loyalty product (its redemption quote and API); the value comes off the total and the points are taken back if placement fails.

elements.name: Success page
elements.description: Confirmation with next steps that follow the real order: payment method and status, delivery kind, the merchant's own timing texts, bank details and proof upload for unpaid transfers.

elements.name: Policies notice
elements.description: Links to the merchant's policies (or Content & Policies documents) at checkout, with required consents whose versions are stored on the order.

elements.name: Sign-in gate
elements.description: Asks for the shopper's identity (the website's identity issuer, e.g. the Signups product, through SS-Identity) never, always, for cash on delivery or above a total — enforced at placement.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Cart, form, placement, manual payments, offers, loyalty, success page, policies and the sign-in gate; payment proofs and the gateway preview as add-ons.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything with higher bounds; the gateway preview as an add-on.
